name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.217: file-retry is removed from code and GUI - the file-missing give-up, its setting and
    its tracker type are gone. The gone-file case is the Database Refresh's job now (new phase 1b,
    path-keyed and behind the same root fail-safe as its neighbours), which is what the operator's
    "alleinige Aufgabe database refresh" asks for. Two page texts corrected with it: the reset warning
    no longer claims the dedup state survives (it is exactly what a reset deletes), and the pacing
    field drops its "rate, not a limit" aside.
